question: A pipe under the kitchen sink burst and soaked the laminate floor. Is that covered under Hausrat Comfort, and can I settle a 3,400 EUR claim on my own authority?
answer: The Hausrat Comfort policy covers water damage from burst pipes under the kitchen sink as escape of tap water is an insured peril [KB-HR-AVB#insured-perils, KB-HR-AVB#water-damage-escape-of-tap-water]. Claims handlers have authority to settle property claims up to 5,000 EUR on their own [KB-PROP-GUIDE#settlement-authority]. Therefore, you can settle the 3,400 EUR claim on your own authority.

question: The weather service measured wind force 7 at the address when roof tiles fell onto the garden furniture. Does storm cover apply?
answer: Storm cover requires wind force of at least 8 on the Beaufort scale. Wind force 7 is not considered storm damage, so the policy does not cover damage from roof tiles falling due to wind force 7. This applies to Hausrat Comfort home contents insurance, which covers storm damage only from wind force 8 or higher [KB-HR-AVB#storm-and-hail].

question: When do we waive the underinsurance deduction on a home contents claim?
answer: For Hausrat Comfort home contents insurance, the underinsurance deduction is waived if the sum insured is at least 650 EUR per square metre of living area at the time of the loss. If this condition is not met, the payout is reduced proportionally to the sum insured relative to the actual value of the contents [KB-HR-AVB#underinsurance-waiver].

question: A basement was flooded after heavy rain. Is that covered, and is there a deductible?
answer: Flooding of a basement due to heavy rain is covered only if the policy includes the natural hazards add-on (Elementarschaden-Baustein) to the Hausrat (home contents) insurance. This add-on covers damage from flooding including heavy rain (Starkregen) and backwater (Rückstau) if a functional backwater protection is in place. There is a deductible (Selbstbehalt) of 500 EUR per claim. Coverage starts after a one-month waiting period from the add-on start date [KB-ELEMENTAR-DE#versicherte-gefahren, KB-ELEMENTAR-DE#selbstbehalt-und-wartezeit, KB-ELEMENTAR-DE#rueckstau, KB-HR-AVB#insured-perils].

question: The policyholder e-mailed new bank details for the payout. Can I just update the IBAN and pay?
answer: You must not update the IBAN or pay based on an e-mail alone. The policy requires a callback to the phone number on file (a verified channel) and written confirmation from the policyholder to change bank details. Payouts go only to the IBAN on file until this process is completed [KB-PROP-GUIDE#payout-and-bank-details].

answer: An on-site adjuster is required for water damage claims with an estimated loss above 10,000 EUR, so for your 14,000 EUR claim, an adjuster is needed. Regarding settlement authority, claims handlers may settle property claims up to 5,000 EUR on their own. Claims between 5,000.01 EUR and 25,000 EUR require team lead approval. Since your claim is 14,000 EUR, team lead approval is necessary before settlement [KB-PROP-GUIDE#adjuster-involvement] [KB-PROP-GUIDE#settlement-authority].

question: Repair costs are 125% of the car's replacement value. Can the customer still have it repaired at our expense?
answer: If repair costs are 125% of the car's replacement value, the customer can still have the vehicle repaired at Contoso's expense. This is allowed as long as the repair costs do not exceed 130% of the replacement value, the repair is done professionally as per the expert report, and the owner uses the vehicle for at least six months afterwards. Above 130%, Contoso pays the replacement value minus residual value instead [KB-MOTOR-GUIDE#repair-or-total-loss-130-percent-rule].

question: When should a burglary claim be referred to SIU?
answer: A burglary claim should be referred to the Special Investigations Unit (SIU) when 3 or more red flags are present. Red flags include no signs of forced entry, sum insured increased within the last 6 months, claim within 90 days of policy start, high-value items without receipts, inconsistent police report, and previous similar claims. Do not inform the policyholder about the referral to SIU [KB-SIU-PLAYBOOK#referral-rule, KB-SIU-PLAYBOOK#red-flags-for-staged-burglary].
